thread.title: IDC: 3Q Decline in Smartphone Shipments 'Raises Questions' About Market

author: morningstar.com
title: IDC: 3Q Decline in Smartphone Shipments 'Raises Questions' About Market
text:
By Josh Beckerman
Third-quarter smartphone shipments totaled 355.2 million units, down 6% from a year earlier, according to preliminary data from research firm International Data Corp.
IDC said this was the fourth consecutive quarter of year-over-year declines, "which raises questions about the market's future."
IDC "maintains its view that the market will return to growth in 2019, but at this stage it is too early to tell what that growth will look like."
Samsung Electronics Co. (SSNHZ), in first place by market share, with 20.3%, posted a 13.4% shipment decline. Second-place Huawei Technologies Co. (HWI.YY) had a 32.9% increase, while Apple Inc. (AAPL) rose 0.5%.
On Thursday, Apple reported its fourth consecutive quarter of record revenue and profit but gave a revenue outlook that disappointed some investors.
